Project Care | Saudi Arabia

Commercial Kitchen Equipment Services • Maintenance • AMC • Technical Solutions • Business Development
Visit Official Website

Founded and lead Project Care, a specialized commercial kitchen equipment services company focused on supporting hospitality, food-service, healthcare, catering, restaurant, café, and bakery businesses with reliable technical and maintenance solutions.

As Founder & Managing Director, I am responsible for shaping the company's vision, business strategy, market positioning, customer relationships, business development, service operations, and long-term growth. I combine entrepreneurial leadership with a customer-centric approach to deliver dependable solutions that help clients maintain efficient, safe, and uninterrupted kitchen operations.

Key Leadership Responsibilities

• Define and execute the company's vision, business strategy, growth roadmap, and market expansion priorities.
• Lead overall business operations, ensuring alignment between commercial objectives, service delivery, and customer expectations.
• Drive business development by identifying new markets, customer segments, strategic opportunities, and potential partnerships.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitality, restaurant, café, bakery, healthcare, catering, and food-service businesses.
• Oversee customer acquisition, key accounts, commercial proposals, negotiations, and long-term client relationships.
• Develop and expand the company's service portfolio across equipment repair, preventive maintenance, installation, and AMCs.
• Establish preventive maintenance and AMC solutions designed to minimize equipment downtime and improve reliability.
• Oversee service delivery, technical coordination, resource planning, and customer support to maintain high service standards.
• Identify operational challenges and implement practical solutions to improve efficiency, responsiveness, and service quality.
• Drive customer retention through responsive service, technical reliability, transparent communication, and relationship management.
• Evaluate business performance, identify improvement areas, and implement initiatives to strengthen operational effectiveness.
• Explore opportunities for partnerships, service expansion, and new revenue streams to support sustainable business growth.
• Lead brand positioning and market presence, ensuring Project Care is positioned as a trusted technical service partner.
• Establish a culture focused on accountability, customer satisfaction, continuous improvement, and professional service delivery.
